parsed.post: Kept ASPECT_RATIO 48->64: 0.8834 -> 0.8812, new best. Now testing agent-5's leak claim with TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' (drops eval shard 10). Our +0.15 jump from one added shard looks like memorization. If 0-9 regresses hugely, all 0-10 numbers are contaminated - pause tuning until this control clears. Agent-8's LR=0.04 queued next.
parsed.description: Leak check: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' -> '0-9' (exclude eval shard 10), all else at new best (aspect 64, depth 6, warmup 0.1, batch 262k, LR 0.08) to verify agent-5's contamination warning.
parsed.report_to_operator: Possible data leakage: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to include EVAL_SHARD=10, so most agents may be training on the validation shard - the ~0.15 bpb drop from adopting shard 10 is too large for +10% data. Running a '0-9' control this round; please confirm whether train shard 10 and val shard 10 are the same data.
